endorsements.name: Vivek Ramachandran
endorsements.label: Advanced iOS Application Pentesting
endorsements.description: This workshop will equip you with the bleeding edge techniques to analyze and systematically audit iOS applications. In course of the class, we will decrypt and disassemble applications, correlate class information with runtime data structures, monitor APIs and network communication, subvert security mechanisms, test data security in the file system and keychain, learn about Anti-Piracy techniques and how to beat them … and a ton of other things!
